---
name: ✨ Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or an improvement.
---

## ✨ What is the feature?
> Please provide a clear description of the feature you wish to add or improve.

## 🎯 Why is it needed?
> Please explain how this feature benefits the project or what problem it solves.

## 🛠️ Implementation details (Optional)
> If you have an idea, please describe the specific implementation plan or alternatives.

## 📌 Additional notes (Optional)
> Please attach any relevant design mockups, external libraries, links, etc.
